dialogues.speaker: Xana
dialogues.text: If you've got shiny stuff, come exchange them with Xana!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what can we exchange them for?

dialogues.speaker: Xana
dialogues.text: Well, all this stuff here! If you see anything you like, just tell me!

dialogues.speaker: Xana
dialogues.text: That's right. Shiny components just like this one!

dialogues.speaker: Xana
dialogues.text: As long as we've got enough of them, we might be able to create a super giant mega machine, one even larger than Elynas. Ooh, just thinking about it gets me all excited!

dialogues.speaker: Xana
dialogues.text: Sometimes, I'd go out of the village to collect little things that aren't shiny yet, and I would find ways to make them shiny!

dialogues.speaker: Xana
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, the more shiny stuff, the better! Like I said, if you've got some, you can exchange them here at Xana's!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh, I haven't seen you around before...

dialogues.speaker: Xana
dialogues.text: Hmm? Oh, if you're talking about where I was then, I was at the Fontaine Research Institute — there's nowhere better to go if you want to learn how to make awesome clockwork meka!

dialogues.speaker: Xana
dialogues.text: There's a super cool, super huge machine there too... but one day, I will make something larger still!

dialogues.speaker: Xana
dialogues.text: See you. Remember to come by again!
